notes: Passive 2-way indoor/outdoor loudspeaker (5.25" woofer + 3/4" tweeter), 8 ohm direct or 70V/100V multi-tap transformer (30W/15W/7.5W/3.7W taps). No powered electronics, so there is a single signal input and no AC/DC power port. Input is a screw-down terminal strip (barrier-style block accepting bare wire up to 12 AWG or open spade lugs #6/#8/#10) — mapped to the closest available connector id "euroblock" since a bare barrier-strip/terminal-block id is not in the provided list. Sold/shipped in pairs; each unit has one input terminal block (not a loop-through pair of jacks). Optional weatherproof cover kits (MTC-PC2/PC3) are accessories, not part of base I/O.
